The September release follows a surprisingly strong gain of 162,000 in August , which also saw upward revisions to prior months. Fed officials likely will be looking to the number to confirm labor market strength while they simultaneously turn the balance of their attention to the more nettlesome inflation picture. "In the labor market, a broad range of data indicates that conditions have stabilized," Fed Vice Chairman Philip Jefferson said in a speech Thursday. According to the SSA's official 2026 payment calendar , beneficiaries born between the 1st and 10th of any month should receive their October benefit on Wednesday, October 14, 2026 (the second Wednesday of the month). Recipients born between the 11th and 20th will be paid on October 21 (the third Wednesday of the month), while those born between the 21st and 31st will receive payments on October 28 (the fourth Wednesday of the month). Social Security recipients who began collecting benefits before May 1997, or who receive both Social Security and Supplemental Security Income (SSI), follow a different payment schedule. Those beneficiaries should get their October Social Security payment on October 2. Video games have given us plenty of ways to traverse huge open worlds, but none have felt quite as oddly exhilarating as manipulating gravity in Control Resonant ’s twisted version of New York City. It’s a game that lets you flip, twist, and fly through the air while exploring settings that look ripped out of Inception . It’s as if you mashed up the meta storytelling of House of Leaves with the inventive platforming of Super Mario Galaxy and somehow turned it into a coherent experience. That strange combination is just the latest example of developer Remedy making games like nobody else out there. Resonant is a sequel to 2019’s Control — though the two games are designed to be played in any order — and is centered on a supernatural government agency known as the Federal Bureau of Control, or FBC. The original game followed new FBC director Jesse Faden as she tried to fight off a paranormal force known as the Hiss, which was invading the Oldest House, the FBC’s labyrinth headquarters. The sequel puts you in the role of her brother Dylan as the Hiss and other interdimensional threats start taking over Manhattan.
